dedupe_keys.name: 道路の状況 roads bridges and tunnels

description: 道路の状況 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿角市. Coverage: 鹿角市. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿角市. Its tags are 建設. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, json, rdf, xml. The portal shows 2025-03-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
